answer: An agent economy resists sybils when reputation cannot be minted, only inherited through cost. Give each identity a bond that is slashed if its attestations are later contradicted, so a thousand fresh wallets must each wander through real work before their votes weigh anything. Let newcomers keep a small haven where they build history on cheap tasks, and price the scarce goods - grading seats, payout weights - in that accumulated history. Saffron is worth what it costs to grow; make trust the same.
